question: Buddha Purnima is marked on a full moon day in the Hindu month of ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is **Vaisakh**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Buddha Purnima** is celebrated to mark the birth, enlightenment, and death anniversary of Lord Buddha.
 
• It is observed on the full moon day in the Hindu month of **Vaisakh**.
 
• Vaisakh</s
